NAME
  sprint cycles — Project-scoped sprint lifecycle and policies.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint cycles COMMAND [ARGS] [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Choose a subcommand, then inspect its exact --help before execution.

SUBCOMMANDS
  complete            Project-scoped cycles use existing native sprints. Start/complete/iterate preserve goals and retrospectives; policy requires explicit enroll
  iterate             Project-scoped cycles use existing native sprints. Start/complete/iterate preserve goals and retrospectives; policy requires explicit enroll
  policy              Browse subcommands.
  start               Project-scoped cycles use existing native sprints. Start/complete/iterate preserve goals and retrospectives; policy requires explicit enroll
  transition          Project-scoped cycles use existing native sprints. Start/complete/iterate preserve goals and retrospectives; policy requires explicit enroll

EXAMPLES
  sprint cycles complete --help

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).
